settingsToApply.name: Framework Preset
settingsToApply.value: Other (vercel.json also sets "framework": null). Build Command and Install Command: blank (VC-13). No environment variables.

settingsToApply.name: Root Directory / Output Directory
settingsToApply.value: Root Directory: the bundle root, where vercel.json sits (whether vercel.json must sit at the project root when a Root Directory is set was not established: HR-06). Output Directory: site (also in vercel.json).

settingsToApply.name: Deployment Protection
settingsToApply.value: Decide deliberately and record it. Whether previews are protected by default was reported inconsistently by the documentation results (HR-14), so this bundle does not rely on it. Making a preview publicly reachable is a conscious setting change with its own approval (D-P3-5). Keep X-Robots-Tag: noindex (VC-16).

settingsToApply.name: Custom domain
settingsToApply.value: The client domain, at its root (D-P3-2); www to apex is a domain setting, not a rewrite.

settingsToApply.name: Strict-Transport-Security
settingsToApply.value: The platform default for a custom domain is max-age=63072000 without includeSubDomains; *.vercel.app domains additionally get includeSubDomains; preload from the platform whatever vercel.json says, so the never-preload rule cannot apply there (VC-15). vercel.json sets the policy value for a custom domain; read the live header to see which one wins (unverified).

unverifiedLive: that a 404.html in the output directory is served with status 404
what /404 and /404.html do (modelled: answered with the 404 page)
that vercel.json at the bundle root works with the Root Directory setting (HR-06)
that the HSTS header in vercel.json replaces the platform default for a custom domain (VC-15); *.vercel.app domains get includeSubDomains; preload from the platform whatever vercel.json says
how several matching header entries combine when a key repeats (the open-source routing code sets it again)
that the source "/(.*)" is not treated as a named segment (which would change how colons in header values are read, VC-06)
that the routing library's /index and /x/index redirects (modelled) are what the platform does
the content types served for .xml, .txt, .webm, .mp4 and .woff2
Range support for the hero video
that request paths are matched case-sensitively, so /Products is not answered from products.html (modelled; the pages read do not say, and nothing was observed live)
that the deployed bytes equal the staged bytes (checklist C-07)
Deployment Protection state (whether previews are protected by default was reported inconsistently, HR-14) and the preview X-Robots-Tag (VC-16)

capabilities.unknownPath: not-found (the platform answers; a 404.html in the output directory is used when present; the status of that response is not established)
capabilities.previewNoindex: automatic on preview URLs, not on a custom domain of a non-production branch
capabilities.previewProtection: a project setting (Deployment Protection); the default was reported inconsistently (HR-14)
capabilities.ranges: assumed to be answered with 206 (not established)

noCredential: This bundle holds no hosting credential, account, project or team identifier and cannot deploy anything.
